# Backup policy

Backup retention is fourteen days.

Backups are encrypted before transfer.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Harbor health guide

Harbor health listens on port 8042.

Readiness requires a writable spool.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Restart procedure

Release the lease, then restart the worker.

Record the restart in the maintenance journal.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Ledger export

Ledger exports use tab-separated UTF-8 records.

The final row contains a checksum.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Image gallery

Export ledger artwork as a large poster.

This design note does not specify the ledger data format.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Rollout

Before rollout, save the previous deployment manifest.

Verify the health endpoint after deployment.

versions.label: v1
versions.text:
# Rollback

Rollback restores the previous manifest and restarts the service.

Verify service health before closing the rollback.
